backups.loadFailed: The backup settings could not be loaded
backups.title: Backups
backups.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved
backups.testOk: Destination reachable: write, read and delete succeeded
backups.deleteFailed: The destination could not be deleted
backups.intro: Daily off-site copy of every account (site code, data, databases) and of the panel. Everything is encrypted on this server with your passphrase before it leaves: the destination never sees the content.
backups.passphraseHint: Keep it outside the platform (password manager, safe): without it, no backup can be restored.
backups.enabledHint: Every account (unless excluded in its Backups tab), then the panel.
backups.includePanelHint: Panel database and configuration file (needed to rebuild the platform after a server loss).
backups.noDestinations: No destination yet: add an SFTP server or an S3-compatible bucket (AWS, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, Scaleway, OVH, MinIO…).
backups.hostKeyHint: Server key pinned at the first successful test
backups.destinationSaveFailed: The destination could not be saved
backups.name: Name
backups.localWarning: A folder on this server's data disk: it does not protect against the loss of the server. For tests, or a mounted external disk.
backups.hostKeyPin: The server key is recorded at the first successful test; a different key later is refused.
backups.passphraseReplaceWarning: The backups already made stay encrypted with the OLD passphrase: the panel will no longer be able to restore them. Keep the old one if you may need them.
backups.passphraseAck: I have stored this passphrase outside the platform. Without it, the backups cannot be restored.
backups.deleteDestinationConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? The backups already written there stay on it but can no longer be restored from the panel.
backups.accountNotScheduled: The daily backups are not enabled on the platform (Settings > Backups).
backups.accountScheduled: This account is backed up every day off-site, encrypted: site code, site data, release history and databases.
backups.accountExcluded: This account is excluded from the daily backups.
backups.accountInclude: Include this account in the daily backups
backups.restoreCodeHint: The code went back into the staging folder: it goes live with the next release (automatic or to publish, depending on the site).
backups.restoreWarning: Each element chosen is REPLACED by its backed-up state: the current files of the folder (or the current content of the database) are deleted first.
backups.nothingToRestore: Nothing in this backup that you may restore.
backups.restoreRepoHint: The release history is back as it was at the backup: its releases can be rolled back to again. The live site does not change.
backups.restoreConfirmMessage: These {{count}} element(s) are REPLACED by their backed-up state:
backups.siteHint: The backups of the account that hold this site: its code (back into the staging folder) and its data can be restored from here; the databases from their instance page.
backups.dbHint: The backups of the account that hold a database of this instance: each one can be restored from here; the code and data of the sites from the site.
